shortDescription: BPSSC Physical Test Cancellation Notice 2026 released. Download the official notice PDF and check the latest instructions from the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission.
content:
Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has published an official notice regarding the cancellation of a physical test.

Candidates connected with the concerned BPSSC recruitment should download the notice PDF and verify the affected examination, physical-test schedule and further instructions. Any revised date or additional update will be published through the official BPSSC website.

Important instruction

Read the complete official PDF carefully and rely only on the BPSSC website for any revised physical-test schedule or candidate instructions.
